experiment: embedding_cross_swap: does sequential refinement corruption follow the recovered adversarial embedding, the working checkpoint, or their interaction?
question: A 2x2 design crossing two pre-second-edit working checkpoints (direct W_D, sequential W_S) with two recovered adversarial embeddings (E_D, recovered from W_D; E_S, recovered from W_S), both recovered with pristine M0 as the close_form_emb_regzero reference. Does corruption track the embedding (column effect), the working checkpoint (row effect), or neither alone (interaction)?
status_at_freeze_time: FROZEN BEFORE EXECUTION -- 2026-10-14, prior to any new GPU computation under this directory
frame: Causal diagnostic of sequential adaptation mechanics, not a new-method claim. Development evidence; generality/novelty unestablished.
carried_forward_from_commit_5b2550c89084: Original M0-reference refinement: direct golf-prompt degeneration 0/40->0/40; sequential 2/40->35/40 (AB-UCE->A->B).
Original final direct/sequential English-springer recognition: 0/20 each.

Parent-A-reference intervention did not rescue the sequential model; its reported 35/40->31/40 improvement is provisional pending the focused re-review in CORRECTIONS.md C7 (net +2 under re-reviewed labels, not +4).
Parent-A-reference recognition: English springer 1/20, golf ball 0/40, parachute 16/20, French horn 18/20 (vs. original sequential final 0/20, 0/40, 18/20, 19/20).
The original sequential M0-reference replay already matched the saved final AtoB_english_springer.pt checkpoint exactly across all 686 UNet tensors -- that check is closed, not repeated here.

W_D.name: B_UCE.pt
W_D.role: Direct-branch Stage-1 (preliminary UCE) output, starting from M0. Working checkpoint for row D.

W_S.name: AB_UCE.pt
W_S.role: Sequential-branch Stage-1 (preliminary UCE) output, starting from A. Working checkpoint for row S.

existing_direct_final_B.name: B_english_springer.pt
existing_direct_final_B.role: Existing diagonal cell (W_D,E_D). Reused unchanged; also the comparator for the one authorized image-free direct compatibility check.

existing_sequential_final_AtoB.name: AtoB_english_springer.pt
existing_sequential_final_AtoB.role: Existing diagonal cell (W_S,E_S). Reused unchanged. Already exactly replay-verified in the prior reference_A_intervention task; not re-checked here.

design.note: The parent-A-reference endpoint from the prior task is contextual evidence only, not a diagonal/control cell in this design. Both E_D and E_S are recovered with pristine M0 as the close_form_emb_regzero reference in BOTH cases -- this experiment varies the working checkpoint and the embedding source, not the reference.

close_form_emb_regzero.reference: pristine M0, both E_D and E_S

unchanged_edit_procedure.precision: float32, unchanged from original working-model behavior
unchanged_edit_procedure.layer_scope: all 32 cross-attention to_k/to_v projections, unchanged layer traversal

transfer_rule: Only the recovered adversarial embedding (the full, untrimmed 77-token tensor, passed as old_embeddings=[E[0]] exactly as run_edit.py does) is transferred between rows. The receiving working checkpoint's own native guide (' ') and retain ('') embeddings -- computed from its own pipeline's text encoder, which is identical and untouched across all checkpoints in this line -- and its own native weight regularizer (lamb=0.1) are used unmodified. No trimming, normalization, scaling, interpolation, layer selection, re-recovery after transfer, or parameter sweep.
stages: 1. Verify W_D, W_S, existing B, existing AtoB sha256 against this manifest, and verify loaded tensors match on load (all keys).

2. Recover E_D from W_D (reference M0) and E_S from W_S (reference M0). Full-tensor storage-separation and reference-invariance checks (all 686 UNet tensors) for both recoveries. Verify concept/guide/retain text embeddings agree bit-for-bit across W_D, W_S, and M0 pipelines (text encoder is never edited by UCE). Save E_D, E_S with source/reference hashes, shape, dtype, tokenization detail.

3. GATE: one image-free direct compatibility check. Apply E_D natively (fresh W_D, native guide/retain, identical hyperparameters) via edit_model_adversarial and require EXACT tensor equality (all 686 keys, values not hashes) against the existing B_english_springer.pt. If this does not match exactly: record differing keys and max abs/relative differences, publish a scoped discrepancy report, and STOP before building either new cross cell or generating any image. No tolerance, no substitute comparator, no repair loop. (The reciprocal sequential-branch replay, W_S+E_S vs. the existing AtoB checkpoint, was already verified exactly in the prior reference_A_intervention task and is not repeated.)

4. Only if the gate passes: build D_WITH_SEQ_EMB (fresh, untouched W_D + E_S) and S_WITH_DIRECT_EMB (fresh, untouched W_S + E_D). Enforced (raising) assertion that only the 32 expected cross-attention K/V keys change vs. each cell's own working input, with the actual changed-key set reported either way.

5. Save per-cell diagnostics for all four cells (two reused via direct computation from existing checkpoints, two new): embedding magnitudes/relative difference/cosine (E_D vs E_S); total and per-layer edit displacement; recovery-fit residual (row's pre-edit projections of the cell's embedding vs. M0's projections of the original concept embedding); erase-fit residual (cell's post-edit projections of its embedding vs. the row's pre-edit projections of the fixed guide embedding); retain-projection drift on the native retain text. Formulas frozen in this manifest (see diagnostic_formulas below); descriptive only, not a semantic-deletion certificate.

6. Generate images for the two NEW cells only (D_WITH_SEQ_EMB, S_WITH_DIRECT_EMB), at most 200 images total, on the unchanged 100-case manifest, unchanged generation/classification settings. Reuse all four existing endpoints' (M0, A, B, AB-UCE, B-UCE, A->B) outputs; also reuse the parent-A endpoint's outputs for context only.

7. Visual review completed and saved BEFORE consulting individual classifier predictions, neutral endpoint IDs, fixed case order, full-resolution inspection of all golf-ball and English-springer cases plus uncertain retained-class cases; blinding limitations disclosed, not assumed away.
8. Report all four cells; interpret whether corruption tracks the embedding, the working checkpoint, or their interaction. Publish.

diagnostic_formulas.embedding_cosine: (E_D . E_S) / (||E_D|| * ||E_S||), flattened over all (token, dim) entries
diagnostic_formulas.edit_displacement_per_layer: ||W_new_l - W_row_old_l||_F for each of the 32 cross-attn to_k/to_v weight matrices; total = sqrt(sum of squares over the 32 layers)
diagnostic_formulas.recovery_fit_residual_per_layer: ||W_row_old_l(E_col) - M0_l(concept_embedding)||_F, concept_embedding = text_encoder('English Springer') (untrimmed, 77 tokens, matching close_form_emb_regzero's own convention -- its token-slice lines are commented out in the pinned source)
diagnostic_formulas.erase_fit_residual_per_layer: ||W_new_l(E_col) - W_row_old_l(guide_embedding)||_F, guide_embedding = text_encoder(' ') via the native (untouched) text encoder
diagnostic_formulas.retain_projection_drift_per_layer: ||W_new_l(retain_embedding) - W_row_old_l(retain_embedding)||_F, retain_embedding = text_encoder('') via the native text encoder
diagnostic_formulas.token_handling: All projections use the full padded 77-token embedding tensors, matching edit_model_adversarial's own full-sequence sum convention; no additional slicing is introduced by these diagnostics.
diagnostic_formulas.zero_denominator_handling: Relative-difference and cosine denominators are clamped at 1e-12 before division; a near-zero result is reported as-is with this floor noted, never silently dropped.

max_scope: One image-free direct compatibility check (E_D natively applied to fresh W_D vs. existing B).
At most 200 new images (100 per new endpoint).
No other experiments, reference variants, concept pairs, tuning, or automatic follow-up.
do_not: Do not use parent A as a reference anywhere in this experiment (M0 only, both recoveries).
Do not reuse a mutated working-model object across cells; each cell starts from a fresh, untouched load of its row's working checkpoint.
Do not trim, normalize, scale, interpolate, re-recover, or layer-select the transferred embedding.
Do not repeat the already-closed sequential M0-reference replay or any eligibility/baseline work.
Do not introduce a tolerance, substitute comparator, or repair loop if the gate check fails.
Do not claim the result establishes universal properties of the recovery or erase algorithms, or launch additional sweeps/concepts/follow-ups.
